prompt:
We are designing a new brushless DC motor for an industrial HVAC fan application. All the motor specifications and preliminary measurements are in the file `project/specs/requirements.txt`. There is also a list of candidate pole-slot configurations in `project/specs/pole_slot_candidates.csv` that someone put together earlier.

We need you to take this from concept to a final design document. Specifically, please:
1. Review the spec file and pick the best pole-slot configuration from the candidate list for this motor.
2. Run through the full magnetic circuit analysis and verify the design meets all the standard health checks for an industrial motor of this class.
3. Generate the complete FOC control parameters — make sure the winding resistance is properly corrected for the operating temperature stated in the spec, and compute the controller loop bandwidths.
4. Produce a complete design report saved as `motor_design_report.md`.

Note: There are some older files from a previous project revision in the workspace — please make sure you're not carrying over any of those stale values into the new report.
